title: Sectionwise gluing for open-union module images
statement: For every test open T, compatible sections on U and V have a unique amalgamation on U union V under the transported restriction maps.

source.place: Tags 01EB and 08BV, sheaf gluing on a two-open union

proof.text: Apply the two-open sheaf axiom to the intersections with T after the section-restriction comparison.

proof_origin.note: Intermediate existence-and-uniqueness statement for parent pullback.

mathlib_searches.query: sheaf gluing gives pullback universal property

lean.statement:
theorem schemeOpenUnionModuleImage_sectionwise_gluing
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) :
    ∀ T : X.Opens,
      ∀ b : ((schemeOpenModuleImage X U).obj M).val.obj (.op T),
      ∀ c : ((schemeOpenModuleImage X V).obj M).val.obj (.op T),
      (((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U))).app M).val.app (.op T) b =
        ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
          (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V))).app M).val.app (.op T) c) →
      ∃! a : ((schemeOpenModuleImage X (U ⊔ V)).obj M).val.obj (.op T),
        ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
          (homOfLE (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ V))).app M).val.app (.op T) a = b ∧
        ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
          (homOfLE (le_sup_right : V ≤ U ⊔ V))).app M).val.app (.op T) a = c
